title: First Nations Health Ombudsperson inaugural reporting and response chain
chain_summary: A First Nations-governed health ombudsperson office received and investigated health-care complaints, published an inaugural report, and prompted a recorded Ministry and Saskatchewan Health Authority review response. Federal reporting documents continued support for the office and a related navigator-network initiative.

stages.summary: The First Nations Health Ombudsperson Office operated complaint intake, advocacy, resolution, and investigation functions under authority derived from Chiefs-in-Assembly.
The office published its inaugural report covering July 2023 through March 2025.
The Health Minister stated that the Ministry of Health and Saskatchewan Health Authority were reviewing the report and its recommendations.
Federal UN Declaration reporting records continued funding for the office and establishment of a Saskatchewan Anti-Indigenous Racism Navigator Network.

governance_note: The office's authority from Chiefs-in-Assembly is distinct from federal funding or provincial health-system response.
relationship_to_existing_cases: No case-specific link to the Saskatoon coerced-sterilization cohort is asserted. The candidate is a separate provincewide accountability chain.
owner_review_reason: Confirm the inaugural report's recommendation structure and obtain the full report text before creating a developed dossier or publication-facing chain.
